newsitem.title: USA: Miami financial oversight board meets tonight.
newsitem.headline: Miami financial oversight board meets tonight.

text.p: The newly appointed financial oversight board for the city of Miami was scheduled to hold its second meeting on Monday evening, Governor Lawton Chiles said.
The meeting was to begin at 1800 EST/2300 GMT and to resume for another round of talks on Tuesday at 1000 EST/1500 GMT, according to a statement issued by the governor.

The oversight board was appointed by the governor last week to help Miami end its $68 million budget deficit for the year that began Oct 1. The panel is headed by Lt. Gov. Buddy MacKay and four longtime Miami business and government officials.
Miami Mayor Joe Carollo has proposed closing the budget gap by renegotiating leases and selling some city land, but he does not want to raise property taxes or garbage fees.
